But having dropped to $0.55 it's still STUPIDLY overvalued.

The beating continues…

#bitcoin now $35k. As mentioned last night, looks like little support until low $30ks

#dogecoin now at $0.22 and in absolute free fall, down 54% in the past 24 hrs. 

With no sane justification for its value, #doge can easily drop much farther…

#BITCOIN FALLS TO $41k

It's now in dangerous territory. Its price chart doesn't suggest much technical support from here until the low $30ks.

#Dogecoin also weakening, too.

Lots of recent buyers now sitting on increasingly painful losses. https://t.co/GBog8kUAjT

@MishGEA Have you been reading my twitter feed, Mike?  :)

Been making the same case about Dogecoin and taking more than a few arrows for it this week...

@TCrawdad444 I'm not rooting for the collapse of Bitcoin or any other crypto (except Dogecoin, which I think is scamming those buying it)

All I'm trying to do is interpret the data as I see it. For Bitcoin, it's suggesting that it's in a price correction phase that is likely to go lower.

@momari1985 @Jade8888888 @BotOfDogecoin OK, so Dogecoin is using GitHub. So are tens of thousands of other companies around the world.

How does that justify that DOGE has value?

Seriously... besides either:

1. "Because it was bid up to $0.70 for reasons I don't understand"
2. "Because Elon"
3. "Because I believe in magic"

Can anyone give me a remotely credible reason why #dogecoin should be worth anything over a fraction of a penny?

GOING TO THE DOGS

Welp, #dogecoin just cracked below $0.20

It's now fallen more than 2/3 from its May high. And is looking a lot less "fun & friendly" to those sitting on serious losses.

I still think it highly probable #doge is headed back to under $0.01

A TALE OF TWO CRYPTOS

 If you’ve owned #Bitcoin for a week, you’ve lost 25% of your money. 

If you’ve owned #Dogecoin for a week, you’ve lost 50% of it https://t.co/IMx5FhEAjJ

The founder of #dogecoin declares cryptos just as nefarious (or more) than our current fiat-based system:

His entire thread is an epic read:
https://t.co/IxEpSdvo3K

Within the same week, both the founder of #dogecoin & the co-founder of #ethereum issue darkly negative rejections of the #crypto space

That's a notable development that shouldn't be ignored.

HODLers should at least take the time to understand the concerns they're raising.

#dogecoin down to $0.165

That's another $650mil gone in just over an hour...
